However, the Emmy Awards ceremony's "In Memoriam" segment astonishingly snubbed the Walker, Texas Ranger star — a near-kick from beyond the grave.

Norris was best known for martial arts action films, but he also carved out a place in television history playing lawman Cordell Walker in Walker, Texas Ranger (1993–2001).

Norris passed away in March at the age of 86, just days before the Oscars ceremony, and was likewise absent from that event.

But for many viewers, what they remember most is the cowboy swagger of Walker.

Among the names featured in the Emmy tribute were Rob Reiner and Catherine O'Hara.

According to Deadline, others left off the NBC broadcast list included Buffy the Vampire Slayer actor Nicholas Brendon, Melrose Place's Patrick Muldoon, and game show host Jaye P. Morgan.

All of them did appear on the official Emmys website "In Memoriam" page, though it required a bit of scrolling to find. A Television Academy spokesperson added that there is also "a much more extensive video" on the website.

"The In Memoriam segment is only a few minutes and the number of people who can be mentioned in that broadcast is naturally limited," the spokesperson wrote in an email.
